passives.name: Emperor of Ruin
passives.description: (Passive Effect) Grants Courage Against Despair to the enemy team. Grants a special effect to the enemy team based on their class. Striker: Increased damage Mage: +50% Priority recovery efficiency Defender: Inflicts reduced Defense on the Boss for 4 turns when performing an action Ranger: Inflicts reduced Resilience on the Boss for 4 turns when performing an action Healer: Inflicts reduced Speed on the Boss for 4 turns when performing an action
